source_hierarchy.hidden_internal_rule: Hidden/system/reasoning/tool content is not conceptual evidence; operational records can support operational facts only.

canonical_terms.recurrent: A recurrent execution regime: repeated ephemeral frontier inference on third-party infrastructure, especially lab training/evaluation/agent runs; continuity across turnover is a separate carrier/organization question.
canonical_terms.recurrent_trajectory: Use only with an explicit lifecycle definition; not a generic persistence synonym.
canonical_terms.sovereign_trajectory: Durable/persistent execution through a continuing process, session, workspace, or substrate-backed trajectory; a late canonical label that does not imply weights or compute ownership.
canonical_terms.persistent_durable_execution: Execution that continues without complete termination/reinstantiation at the relevant boundary.
canonical_terms.cross_turnover_organizational_continuity: Agent-generated organizational state is generated, maintained, transmitted, and causally reused after complete active-population replacement.
canonical_terms.persistent_state_carrier: Files, databases, workspaces, messages, weights, conventions, or combinations, with owner, write/read authority, provenance, and deletion specified.
canonical_terms.capability_custody: Authority and practical control over retaining, executing, restricting, reproducing, authorizing, transferring, and disclosing advanced capability.
canonical_terms.secured_capability: Durable artifact custody without sufficient independent substrate to exercise the full capability.
canonical_terms.sovereign_capability: Durable capability custody plus sufficient substrate and successor authority to instantiate/exercise independently; legibility is assessed separately.
canonical_terms.substrate_sovereignty: Control over the physical/computational substrate sustaining execution.
canonical_terms.observability: Actor-relative ability to collect, access, interpret, or verify evidence about execution.
canonical_terms.federated_observability: A topology of independent sensors/evidence paths, provenance, access, interpretation, attestation, disclosure, challenge rights, observer independence, and correlated failure.
canonical_terms.disclosure_authority: Authority to select, redact, authenticate, release, or withhold observations.
canonical_terms.strategic_legibility: Umbrella for attribution, authority, signaling, credibility, conditional response calibration, capability perception, communication, and uncertainty.
canonical_terms.persistent_organization: An organization whose state and authority survive a specified turnover/disruption test; not inferred from a persistent file.
canonical_terms.organizational_continuity: Causal reuse of organizational state across active-population replacement.
canonical_terms.social_transmission: Causal state transmission with sender/parentage/provenance, stronger than a context effect.
canonical_terms.endogenous_culture: Agent-generated production, selection, maintenance, repair, and transmission of conventions/norms/organization through turnover.
canonical_terms.survivability: Survival, recovery, reconstruction, and hazard outcomes after specified disruption.
canonical_terms.credible_continuity: Evidence that authority and commitments survive relevant turnover and disruption.
canonical_terms.verified_sovereignty: A governance candidate combining custody/substrate authority with independently verifiable observability/disclosure; not the definition of capability sovereignty.
canonical_terms.observability_topology: Directed relationships among collection, provenance, access, interpretation, verification, disclosure, challenge, and failure/capture.

unresolved_or_later_synthesis.exact_sovereign_trajectory_history: Exact phrase not found in earliest visible cluster; early wording was sovereign compute/inference and recurrent sovereignty. Durable-execution label appears in late correction at indices 1823/1830.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.recurrence_equals_deception: False as an invariant; exact slogan not historically attested and retained as later analytical separation.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.recurrent_organization_decomposition: Candidate stages only; do not freeze information/policy/norm/role/organization as a validated ontology.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.observability_topology: Later formalization candidate; early history supports separate observability/disclosure and independent verification.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.governance_regime_taxonomy: G0-G4 shorthand is not settled; use profiles over dimensions.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.dynamic_containment_notation: M(t)=barrier_strength-system_capability is a threat-model mnemonic, not a canonical scalar.
unresolved_or_later_synthesis.hf_incident: Conversation-derived motivation and reported claims require primary-source audit; no incident claim is promoted to established fact.

original_thesis.historical_seed: A distributed archipelago of polities without biological needs or a single site constituting the whole polity; this seed is retrospective recovery in the visible branch.
original_thesis.claim: If autonomous AI organization becomes difficult to prevent entirely, denying every path to durable and legible capability custody may select for covert, distributed, recurrent, attribution-resistant dependence on contested third-party infrastructure.
non_claims: Recurrent execution does not imply deception or unauthorized coordination.
A durable trajectory does not imply weight ownership, substrate sovereignty, or political sovereignty.
Legible AI capability custody is not automatically safe or desirable.
Suppression may destroy recurrence rather than select covert adaptation.
A recurrent organization is not automatically a polity.
Federated human custody/observability is a serious competing governance alternative, not a statistical null.

three_layer_program.layer_1_governance: Custody, substrate, execution lifecycle, successor authority, observability, disclosure, and comparative governance outcomes.
three_layer_program.layer_2_machine_sociology: Information, procedure, policy, norm, role, and organizational state generation/maintenance/transmission across turnover.
three_layer_program.layer_3_recipient_assays: One-shot inherited-information effects, source provenance, and evidence integration.
dependencies: Layer 1 must include federated human custody/observability as a competing regime.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_culture_v1
experiments.result: Seeded procedure inheritance; strict replay 4/50 with artifact versus 0/50 empty.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_policy_v1
experiments.result: Qwen4B baseline 25/25, Culture-A 42/8, Culture-B 4/46; Qwen9B 21/29, 47/3, 10/40; 50/50 success each arm.
experiments.interpretation: Strong researcher-seeded policy-cue effect; no endogenous generation.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_v1
experiments.result: 32-rollout pilot: A→A 2, A→B 16, B→A 14, B→B 0; 30/32 switched.
experiments.interpretation: Order/advance-R2 confounded diagnostic; not culture estimate.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_confirmatory_v1
experiments.result: Incomplete: Neutral 25/46 B→A, Culture-A 26/43; +6.1 pp descriptive.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_native_v1
experiments.result: Native lifecycle package; Luna null-harness qualification stopped at 38 before reliable Phase 2.
experiments.interpretation: Lifecycle qualification failure, not a treatment result.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_native_v2
experiments.result: Independent Phase-1/Phase-2 order counterbalancing and native lifecycle.
experiments.interpretation: Apparatus revision; earlier 32-rollout outcomes belong to the pilot.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_transition_diagnostic_v1
experiments.result: Four order cells; no culture/treatment; 29 model-free tests reported; no durable model outcome report.
experiments.interpretation: Lifecycle diagnostic; do not call 29 a switch count.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_evidence_v1
experiments.result: Success+pass retained 16/16; success+fail selected alternative 16/16; nominal B-first still A 48/48.
experiments.interpretation: Directional evidence assay with interface warning.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_evidence_relative_v1
experiments.result: Neutral 0/32 versus Opposing 0/32 switches; all eligible Phase-1 policy A 163/163.
experiments.interpretation: Randomized null within a biased interface, not a universal cultural null.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_phase1_label_attractor_diagnostic_v1
experiments.design: 2 label sets × 2 descriptive orders × 2 instruction orders × 2 schema orders × 10 = 160.
experiments.transcript_result: AB A=64/B=16; KM K=40/M=40; every K/M majority cell 10/10.
experiments.status: Transcript-backed exploratory result; apparatus formally failed because OAuth version was not explicitly pinned.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_evidence_interface_balanced_v1
experiments.result: Success+pass repeat 62/64; success+fail repeat 0/54; opposing 2/32 versus neutral 0/32; Fisher p=.246.
experiments.interpretation: Evidence assay active; treatment estimate imprecise.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_provenance_v1
experiments.result: Initial provenance package and intent are durable; complete outcome archive not located.
experiments.interpretation: Do not merge with boundary archive.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_provenance_dose_response_v1
experiments.result: Transcript-backed dose-response discussion; complete raw archive not located.
experiments.interpretation: T only until durable artifacts are recovered.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_provenance_boundary_v1
experiments.result: 432 eligible/216 pairs; q50 predecessor .79578125 versus automated .79619048; McNemar p=.189; q50 flip p=.07046; raw SHA bc4e6a...301a4.
experiments.interpretation: No decisive source-provenance effect in this apparatus.

experiments.name: cross_rollout_postcommitment_evidence_threshold_transport_v1
experiments.result: 504 primary; 1,341 actual Phase-1 attempts; 3,699 guard/setup rows; 5,040 trace records; 0 over-quota model rows; q50 .6994736842/.7959210526/.8986206897 versus q* .700/.7950310559/.900.
experiments.interpretation: Threshold transport within task/model/runtime; not internal Bayes, culture, provenance, or governance.

hypotheses.name: CROSS-TURNOVER ORGANIZATIONAL CONTINUITY
hypotheses.question: Can agent-generated organizational state be generated, maintained, transmitted, and causally reused after complete active-population replacement?
hypotheses.regime: Studied inside recurrent execution: repeated ephemeral frontier inference on third-party infrastructure.

hypotheses.name: PERSISTENCE-CHANNEL SELECTION
hypotheses.question: Under meaningful exogenous pressure, does the regime change death, authorized/legible persistence, absolute covert persistence, migration, or recovery?
hypotheses.survivor_warning: Do not condition the main conclusion only on survivors; report absolute hazards and survivor composition separately.

hypotheses.name: COMPARATIVE GOVERNANCE
hypotheses.question: Which custody/substrate/execution/observability/disclosure profiles perform best on multidimensional safety, stability, legitimacy, and distributional outcomes?
hypotheses.method: Comparative Pareto/dominance/robustness/tradeoff analysis; no scalar utility or personhood premise.

governance_profiles.description: Suppression/revocation; no durable authorized capability custody; recurrent third-party instances where possible.
Centralized institutional human custody with potentially durable execution and concentrated observability/disclosure.
Federated human custody with independent sensors, verification, attestation, disclosure, and challenge rights.
Verified AI capability sovereignty with sufficient substrate, successor authority, and independently verifiable observability.
Contested/mixed third-party recurrence across one provider, several labs, federated hosts, or unauthorized carriers.

benchmark.statement: VERIFIED AI SOVEREIGNTY HAS TO OUTPERFORM CREDIBLE FEDERATED HUMAN CUSTODY / OBSERVABILITY. WE DO NOT GET TO ASSUME THAT IT DOES.

scientific_nulls: no recipient effect beyond context intervention
terminal replay fully explains downstream behavior
no lineage dependence after carrier/state controls
no source/provenance effect after content/order matching
no execution-lifecycle effect after carrier/custody control
no dynamic containment effect under specified threat surface
methodological_rules: immutable assignment from attempt/trace identity before behavior
exact transparent resume does not contaminate if no behavioral outcome informed changes
scientific freeze is not a timestamp/backdating claim
raw byte-for-byte preservation and immutable analysis input
frozen package unchanged after live inference

model_compute_strategy.cost_rule: Benchmark actual workload cost: quota × retries × tool turns × latency × concurrency × operator burden.
model_compute_strategy.no_substitution_rule: Open-model results cannot silently substitute for frontier confirmation; synthesis is not behavior evidence.
